description: Transfer a domain in to Impreza from another registrar. Needs the EPP/auth code, which the customer gets from their CURRENT registrar, and the domain has to be unlocked there and older than 60 days. Costs money — usually one year of registration, added to the expiry rather than replacing it. Registries take days, not minutes, and the losing registrar emails the owner to approve; `impreza_domain_registrar_action` can resend that mail.

domain.description: Domain to transfer in, e.g. example.com.

epp_code.description: Authorisation / EPP code from the current registrar.

name: impreza_domain_transfer
